```plato

    // The pose of a motor: rotation from the real part, translation
    // t = 2 * Dual * conjugate(IReal).
    Pose3D(m: Motor3D): Pose3D {
        var q = m.Real.Normalize;
        var t = m.Dual * 2.0 * q.Conjugate;
        return (Point3D(t.X, t.Y, t.Z), q);
    }
```

```plato
    // The pose stored in a rigid homogeneous matrix. Precondition: the matrix
    // is a rotation followed by a translation (no scale, shear, or projection).
    Pose3D(m: Matrix4x4): Pose3D
        => (m.Translation.ToPoint, m.Rotation);
```

```plato

    // Rotating about a centre: translate the centre to the origin, rotate,
    // translate back.
    Pose3D(r: RotationAbout3D): Pose3D {
        var c = r.Center.PositionVector;
        return ((c - c.Transform(r.Rotation)).ToPoint, r.Rotation);
    }
```
